stopCondition: All stories pass, required tests and live tenant-isolation flow pass, README is complete, and clean-clone rehearsal succeeds.

stories.title: Scaffold backend and frontend workspaces
acceptanceCriteria: Backend and frontend directories have minimal runnable entry points
Python and Node dependencies are pinned in committed lock or dependency files
No business behavior or placeholder fake upload flow is added
stories.commitMessage: chore: scaffold FastAPI and React applications

stories.title: Add environment and Docker Compose infrastructure
acceptanceCriteria: Compose defines PostgreSQL, MinIO, backend, and frontend services
.env.example contains local placeholders and .env is ignored
Persistent database and object-storage data are ignored
MinIO CORS is restricted to the configured frontend origin
stories.commitMessage: chore: add local Docker Compose infrastructure

stories.title: Create backend configuration and health boundary
acceptanceCriteria: FastAPI loads validated settings from environment
CORS permits only the configured frontend origin
GET /health returns a stable success response
Application errors use a consistent non-sensitive shape
stories.commitMessage: feat: add validated backend configuration and health check

stories.title: Add metadata models and initial migration
acceptanceCriteria: Company, user, and upload models match the architecture specification
Upload status includes pending_upload and all five required statuses
Upload company ID is indexed and object key is unique
Alembic upgrades a fresh PostgreSQL database
checks: Migration applies to a fresh database
stories.commitMessage: feat: add tenant upload metadata schema

stories.title: Seed development identities and resolve current user
acceptanceCriteria: Hospital A, Hospital B, Alice, and Bob are seeded idempotently
X-User-ID resolves to a database user and company server-side
Missing or unknown development users are rejected
Client-provided company identity is never trusted
stories.commitMessage: feat: add seeded development users and tenant context

stories.title: Implement tenant-scoped upload repository
acceptanceCriteria: List query filters by company in SQL
Detail query filters by upload ID and company in SQL
Foreign and absent IDs produce identical not-found outcomes
stories.commitMessage: feat: enforce tenant-scoped upload persistence

stories.title: Create MinIO storage adapter and private bucket initialization
acceptanceCriteria: Internal operations use the Docker endpoint
Presigned URLs use the browser-resolvable endpoint without URL rewriting
Bucket initialization is idempotent and removes anonymous policy
Storage interface can be replaced with a fake in tests
checks: Anonymous bucket request is denied in live stack
stories.commitMessage: feat: add private MinIO storage adapter

stories.title: Validate upload initiation and generate safe object keys
acceptanceCriteria: Required sample ID, filename, classification, and MIME are validated
Unknown fields including company_id and object_key are rejected
Filename is reduced to a safe bounded basename
Object key follows company/upload/safe-filename structure
stories.commitMessage: feat: validate upload metadata and generate scoped object keys

stories.title: Initiate uploads with presigned PUT URLs
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/uploads/initiate derives company from current user
A pending_upload row is stored before success is returned
Response contains upload ID, five-minute PUT URL, and expiry but no credentials
Public response omits internal object key
stories.commitMessage: feat: issue short-lived presigned upload URLs

stories.title: Confirm uploads by verifying the expected MinIO object
acceptanceCriteria: Confirmation authorizes by upload ID and company before storage access
Object key is read from the authorized database row
Missing, empty, or oversized object cannot become uploaded
Existing valid object stores size and ETag and becomes uploaded
Confirmation is safely idempotent
checks: Confirmation success and failure tests pass
stories.commitMessage: feat: verify and confirm completed MinIO uploads

stories.title: Simulate processing state transitions
acceptanceCriteria: Confirmed upload progresses through queued and processing to completed
Processor exception records failed
Background work creates its own database session
README limitation for non-durable local background work is captured in plan notes
checks: Processor success and failure tests pass
stories.commitMessage: feat: simulate research image processing lifecycle

stories.title: Expose tenant-scoped list and detail routes
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/uploads lists only the current company records
GET /api/uploads/{id} returns only an owned record
Foreign and random IDs return the same 404 body
Response schemas omit object key
checks: Hospital A owner and Hospital B denial tests pass
stories.commitMessage: feat: expose tenant-isolated upload records

stories.title: Authorize presigned download URLs
acceptanceCriteria: Download route authorizes before calling storage
Only confirmed accessible objects receive a one-minute GET URL
Hospital B receives the generic 404 for Hospital A upload
Storage presigner is not called for denied requests
checks: Owner download and cross-tenant denial tests pass
stories.commitMessage: feat: authorize short-lived presigned downloads

stories.title: Complete API security regression suite
acceptanceCriteria: All four assignment-mandated tests are explicit and named clearly
Foreign and nonexistent error equivalence is asserted
Arbitrary company and object-key attempts are asserted
Full backend test and lint suites pass
stories.commitMessage: test: cover tenant isolation and upload validation

stories.title: Create typed frontend API client and user switch
acceptanceCriteria: Typed API wrapper consistently sends selected X-User-ID
UI switches clearly between Alice and Bob
User switch refreshes records and clears stale tenant data
Backend remains the authorization authority
stories.commitMessage: feat: add typed API client and development user switch

stories.title: Implement direct browser upload and confirmation
acceptanceCriteria: Controlled form collects required metadata and an image
Browser PUTs file bytes directly to the returned MinIO URL
Browser calls confirm only after successful PUT
Failure at initiate, PUT, or confirm is visible and retryable
checks: Real browser upload creates a MinIO object
stories.commitMessage: feat: implement direct browser-to-MinIO upload flow

stories.title: Show uploads, statuses, downloads, and feedback
acceptanceCriteria: Accessible uploads show required metadata and status
Polling stops or slows when no active states remain
Download requests a fresh authorized URL on click
Loading, empty, success, and error states are clear and accessible
checks: All UI states verified in browser
stories.commitMessage: feat: display tenant uploads statuses and downloads

stories.title: Verify live cross-company end-to-end behavior
acceptanceCriteria: Hospital A uploads, confirms, sees processing, and downloads an actual object
Hospital B list excludes Hospital A upload
Hospital B detail and download attempts return generic 404
Anonymous MinIO listing and direct object read fail
Evidence and exact commands are recorded in progress log
stories.commitMessage: test: verify live MinIO tenant isolation flow

stories.title: Write complete assignment README
acceptanceCriteria: README covers all 13 requested topics
README includes a data-model diagram verified against the final PostgreSQL schema and MinIO separation
Setup, test, upload, and download instructions match verified commands
Security tradeoffs, URL expiry, queue design, and production improvements are honest
AI tool/model usage and personally verified behavior are disclosed
checks: Every assignment README item maps to a heading
stories.commitMessage: docs: explain setup architecture security and AI verification

stories.title: Perform final security and clean-clone rehearsal
acceptanceCriteria: Full backend tests, lint, and frontend build pass
Git diff and tracked files contain no secret or generated runtime data
Clean clone starts using README instructions and .env.example
Commit history is coherent and every story is accounted for
Walkthrough script is rehearsed without unexplained code
stories.commitMessage: chore: complete submission readiness review
